sentences.en: Pineapples contain an enzyme denominated bromelain that decomposes some proteins.
sentences.zh: 菠萝中含有一种名为溴氯化的酶，可以分解一些蛋白质。

sentences.en: All the organic matter in the compost pile is decomposing.
sentences.zh: 堆肥中的所有有机物正在腐烂。

sentences.en: Vermicomposting is a method of decomposing organic waste using worms.
sentences.zh: 蚯蚓堆肥是一种利用蠕虫分解有机废物的方法。
